section_summary.extract_value: This section reports descriptive statistics and correlation analyses from what appears to be a single study examining relationships between BMI, body appreciation (measured with BAS-2), eating psychopathology, social safeness, and self-reassurance. Key findings include a negative correlation between BMI and body appreciation (weak magnitude), positive correlations between social safeness/self-reassurance and body appreciation, and negative associations between these variables and eating disorder examination questionnaire (EDE-Q) scores.
